head.title: Settings & data
head.blurb: Hard rules when you want them. Data stays in this browser unless you export it.

classic.label: Classic Settings
classic.hint: The page this screen is drawn from. To stay there, turn off Native Settings (beta) under Look & feel, Appearance.

rows.title: Light mode
rows.hint: Switch between the dark and light appearance. This only changes how the app looks.

rows.title: Native Nutrition (Beta)
rows.hint: Opt-in native Food preview. Plan, Log and Shopping use your real data; unfinished actions open classic Food.

rows.title: Show tab timing (testing)
rows.hint: After each tab change on the native bar, shows how many milliseconds it took from the tap to the new screen being drawn.

rows.title: Native Overview
rows.hint: Use the Android Overview screen. Turn off to return to the classic Overview.

rows.title: Native Character preview
rows.hint: Native cards and charts. Logging and edits use their existing screens. Turn off for Classic Character.

rows.title: Native Log activity
rows.hint: The native Log screen. Saving uses the same rules and save as the classic form. The classic Log is one tap away: turn this off.

rows.title: Native Workout plan (beta)
rows.hint: The native Workout plan screen. Ticking a set uses the same rules and save as the classic plan; the guided workout and editing open the classic page. Turn off for the classic plan.

rows.title: Native Life Director (beta)
rows.hint: The native Today screen: the dial, the day strip and the running order. Sessions, sheets and the other sections open in the classic Life Director. Turn off for the classic screen.

rows.title: Native Recipes (beta)
rows.hint: The native Recipes screen: search, categories and recipe cards. Logging a recipe opens the classic add-food sheet. Turn off for the classic page.

rows.title: Native Library (beta)
rows.hint: The native Media screen: your list with its search and filters. Adding, editing, removing, ticking an item finished and the audiobook player use the classic page; the Journal stays classic. Turn off for the classic Library.

rows.title: Native Settings (beta)
rows.hint: The native Settings screen: the categories, every switch and choice, and the bottom bar. Typing, times, files, the rewards and the data tools open the classic page. Turn off for the classic page.

cards.title: Bottom bar
cards.intro: Pick which tabs show and what order they sit in (use the arrows). Hidden pages are still reachable from links inside the app. Keep at least two.

show.label: Show Log activity in the bar
Show Workout plan in the bar
Show Life Director in the bar

rows.title: Swipe to switch tabs
rows.hint: Swipe left or right with one finger to move between tabs. Ignored near the screen edges, on scrolling strips, sliders, the cat room and the Life Director.

rows.title: Swipe animation
rows.hint: The page follows your finger as you swipe, then the next page slides in from the side. Turn this off for plain, instant tab switches.

rows.title: Bar scrubbing speed
rows.hint: Slide a finger along the bottom bar to run through the tabs. Faster means a shorter slide gets you further.

rows.text: The Android Back button or gesture closes a popup, then returns to the previous tab. It never closes the app.

rows.title: Card effects
rows.hint: GPU sparkles, holographic foil and tilt on the quest cards. Turn off for plain cards if your phone gets warm or you want to save battery.

rows.title: Quest and dice sounds
rows.hint: Card shuffles, deals and flips, coins when you fulfil a quest, and the Luck dice. Also needs Sound on in the main sound setting.

rows.title: Card deal
rows.hint: The first time you open the Quest Board each day. 3D table lays the cards on a candlelit wooden table in real 3D (skippable). Classic cinematic is the flat version of the same reading. Quick is a short shuffle. Instant just shows the cards.

rows.title: Card art
rows.hint: Which painted deck your quest cards use. Automatic picks the seasonal deck when one is in season. Cards a deck has no art for use the Classic art.

rows.title: Workout screen
rows.hint: 3D gym walks you from machine to machine with a trainer showing the pace of each rep. Classic is the plain screen. Reduced motion always uses classic.

rows.title: 3D diagnostics
rows.hint: Shows a small readout on the workout screen (frames per second, phase, which movement is playing, any error). Useful when something looks wrong.

rows.title: Trainer pack
rows.hint: Optionally replace the built-in trainer with a character from a trainer pack file (made with tools/make_trainer.py). The file stays on this device only and nothing from it is part of the app. None loaded. The built-in trainer is used.

rows.title: Haptic feedback
rows.hint: Little buzzes when you earn XP, change tabs, pet the cat and so on.

rows.text: Strength is set on the phone’s vibration motor, so Strong and Max are properly harder.

cards.title: App updates
cards.intro: New builds come from this app’s GitHub releases. Android asks you to confirm each install.

rows.title: Installed build 290
rows.hint:
No newer compatible update was reported by the server.
Latest release: 290 · Android API 28 / requires 28

rows.title: Voice scheduling
rows.hint: Offline only. Speak or type a request and it goes into Life Director after you confirm.

rows.title: Export Voice Fallback Log
rows.hint: Nothing yet. Anything the voice engine does not understand, and every thumbs up or down you give an answer, is saved here.

rows.title: HD walking
rows.hint: Your cat walks with twice the pixel detail, a redrawn face and expressions. Other animations are still being redrawn one by one. Turn this off if anything looks wrong.

rows.title: Lock the Journal
rows.hint: Ask for your fingerprint or screen lock to open the Journal. It also hides the Journal from the app switcher and screenshots while it is open.

cards.title: Tab previews
cards.intro: Small screenshots of each tab, blurred and shown while you scrub the bottom bar.

rows.title: 1 of 10 tabs captured
rows.hint: These are the blurred pictures shown while you scrub the bottom bar. Each tab updates when you visit it.

cards.title: Home-screen widget
cards.intro: Your Life Director dial on the home screen: today’s plan, a moving hand for now, and what is on or next.

rows.text: Set up Life Director first, then the widget can show your day.

rows.title: 1 on your home screen
rows.hint: The picture updates whenever you leave the app.

rows.title: Refresh the picture
rows.hint: Use after you change your plan. The hand moves on its own.

rows.title: Import from my calendar
rows.hint: Events in your phone’s calendar become fixed blocks in your Life Director, and the rest of the day re-plans around them. Say “Hey Gemini, add dentist tomorrow at 3 PM to my calendar” and it shows up here. Read only.

rows.title: Last check
rows.hint: Not yet

cards.title: Health sync
cards.intro: Turns your Samsung Health activity into XP automatically, through Android’s Health Connect.

rows.title: Sync health data
rows.hint: Workouts, steps, sleep and weight become XP. Read on this phone only.

rows.title: Workouts
rows.hint: Each workout, by how long it lasted.

rows.title: Daily steps
rows.hint: Once a day is over: 2,000+ steps counts, 3 XP per 1,000 up to 15,000.

rows.title: Sleep
rows.hint: Each night of 3+ hours, more XP for 6 to 7+ hours.

rows.title: Weight
rows.hint: Updates your character weight from your latest reading.

rows.title: Daily steps goal
rows.hint: Fills the bar on the Overview.

rows.title: Last sync
rows.hint: never

rows.text: Using Samsung Health? Open it, go to Settings → Health Connect, and let it write exercise, steps, sleep and weight. LifeMax then reads them from Health Connect. Each record is counted once.

rows.title: Branded foods (USDA)
rows.hint: An optional database of packaged foods, kept on this device only. Choose the compact USDA .jsonl.gz file once, then search it from Food, Add food.
Not imported yet · optional

cards.title: Automatic backup
cards.intro: Your data is kept on this phone. Pick a folder, such as Drive or Downloads, and a backup file is written there automatically.

rows.text: No backup folder is chosen, so your progress exists only on this phone.

rows.title: Automatic backup
rows.hint: Saves a backup file into a folder you pick, when you leave the app and one is due. Each file is read back and checked before it counts.

rows.title: Folder
rows.hint: Nothing chosen yet.

rows.title: Keep the newest
rows.hint: Older automatic backups are deleted. Copies taken before an update, an import or a reset are kept apart, the 5 newest of each.

rows.title: Last verified backup
rows.hint: None yet

rows.title: Android device backup
rows.hint:
Let Android copy all of LifeMax, journal and health entries included, to your Google backup (needs a screen lock) and a new phone. When off, Android's copy of LifeMax is emptied at its next backup. The backup folder works either way.
With this off and no backup folder, this phone holds the only copy of LifeMax.

cards.title: Notifications
cards.intro: Smart reminders for workouts and planned sessions. Everything is scheduled on this phone.

rows.title: Reminders
rows.hint: Master switch. Off cancels everything scheduled.

rows.title: Planned sessions
rows.hint: Life Director sessions, shortly before they start.

rows.title: Reminder lead time
rows.hint: How early to nudge you.

rows.title: Workout days
rows.hint: A reminder on days your workout plan has a session, until it is checked off. Skipped when Life Director already reminds you.

rows.title: Evening nudge
rows.hint: A second reminder at 8 PM if today’s workout is still open.

rows.title: Daily check-in
rows.hint: A nightly prompt to log your day (skipped once you have logged something).

rows.title: Quiet hours
rows.hint: No reminders in this window.

rows.text: Reminders are rescheduled whenever you open the app, check something off or change your plan, and cover the next three days.

cards.title: Character profile
cards.intro: Name, build, and profile picture stay on this device.

rows.title: Profile picture
rows.hint: Cropped to a square. Stays in this browser.

cards.title: Rewards
cards.intro: Sparks, perks, accent colours, cat toys, streak shields and attribute ascension.

cards.title: Decay system
cards.intro: After the grace period with no training, the attribute loses XP daily. Skill XP does not decay. Turn this off only if you want a softer game.

cards.title: Developer mode
cards.intro: Testing tools. When on, each attribute sheet gains a test activity that awards +2 levels for that attribute only.

rows.title: Enable developer mode
rows.hint: Adds “Dev: +2 levels” under every attribute’s activity list, and test buttons for the cat (Cat → Developer).

cards.title: XP rules
cards.intro: Edit the base XP for each activity. Changes apply to future logs.

rows.title: Focused reading / study
rows.hint: Knowledge · base XP

rows.title: Focused business work
rows.hint: Entrepreneurship · base XP

rows.title: Strength workout
rows.hint: Lifting · base XP

rows.title: Run / cardio
rows.hint: Running · base XP

rows.title: Language practice
rows.hint: Spanish · base XP

rows.title: Sleep / recovery routine
rows.hint: Recovery Routine · base XP

rows.title: Practical skill practice
rows.hint: Practical Skills · base XP

rows.title: Difficult planned task
rows.hint: Execution · base XP

rows.title: Custom activity
rows.hint: Custom Skill · base XP

rows.title: Export backup
rows.hint: Download all activities, stats, quests and settings.

rows.title: Export report
rows.hint: A readable summary of your character, stats and full history.

rows.title: Import backup
rows.hint: Restore a previously exported Life Max file.

rows.title: Reset demo data
rows.hint: Restore the starter profile and sample quests.

rows.title: Delete all local data
rows.hint: Permanently clear this browser's Life Max save.

rows.text: Prototype privacy: data is stored locally in this browser using localStorage. It is not a secure account system or cloud backup. Anyone using this browser profile may be able to access it. Export a backup before clearing browser data.
